home.heading: We are getting married!
home.photoAlt: Stef and Laz together by the sea at sunset
paragraphs: We’re delighted to welcome you aboard as we celebrate our wedding together.
Join us for an unforgettable evening on the Danube.
Please let us know by 15 May 2027 whether you can join us.

invite.heading: Invite
invite.alt: Wedding invitation for Stef and Laz

venue.heading: The Venue
paragraphs: We’ll celebrate aboard the Európa Hajó, a Budapest event boat on the Danube. For more information about the vessel and its facilities, visit the official Európa Hajó website.
The exact location where the boat will be docked is yet to be confirmed (in the central area between Margaret Bridge and Liberty Bridge), but we will announce it in advance.
venue.photoAlt: The Európa Hajó on the Danube in Budapest

Marinated pink duck breast with fig jam

sections.title: Salads

Thai vegetable curry with rice noodles

sections.title: Side Dishes

contact.heading: Contacts

sections.title: Questions?
paragraphs: Do you have a question about the wedding? Email us at stef.laz.wedding@gmail.com.

sections.title: Share your photos
paragraphs: If you take photos at the venue, we’d love to see them. We won’t share them; we’ll keep them as memories of this special day.

contact.photoAlt: Stef and Laz relaxing together on a couch

gifts.heading: Gifts
paragraphs: The most important thing for us is to bring all our loved ones together, so having you with us is our greatest gift. If you would still like to honour us with a gift, a contribution toward our honeymoon would be wonderful, as physical gifts are a bit complicated for us since we split our time between three countries.

sightseeing.heading: Discover Budapest
sightseeing.intro: If you have time to explore Budapest while you’re here for our wedding, these favourite sights are a wonderful place to start:

attractions.alt: The Hungarian Parliament reflected in the Danube
attractions.title: Hungarian Parliament Building
attractions.text: A striking Gothic Revival landmark on the banks of the Danube.

attractions.alt: Fisherman's Bastion overlooking the Danube and Budapest
attractions.title: Buda Castle & Fisherman's Bastion
attractions.text: Climb Castle Hill for sweeping views across the city.

attractions.alt: The outdoor pools at Széchenyi Thermal Bath
attractions.title: Széchenyi Thermal Bath
attractions.text: Unwind in Budapest's famous thermal waters before the celebration.

attractions.alt: Interior of Veli Bej Thermal Bath in Budapest
attractions.title: Veli Bej Thermal Bath
attractions.text: Step into a restored 16th-century Ottoman bath in the historic Császár complex.

attractions.alt: The domed interior pool at Rudas Thermal Bath
attractions.title: Rudas Thermal Bath
attractions.text: Discover a historic Ottoman bath known for its domed pool and Danube views.

attractions.alt: The colorful courtyard and interior of Szimpla Kert
attractions.title: Szimpla Kert Ruin Bar
attractions.text: Explore Budapest's iconic ruin bar, known for its eclectic rooms, courtyard and lively atmosphere.

attractions.alt: Garden courtyard at Grandio Jungle Grill Bar
attractions.title: Grandio Ruin Bar
attractions.text: A leafy courtyard bar with relaxed garden seating, food and evening music.

attractions.alt: Aerial view of the Hungarian National Museum
attractions.title: Hungarian National Museum
attractions.text: Discover Hungarian history and culture in a landmark neoclassical museum.

attractions.alt: The neoclassical Museum of Fine Arts in Budapest
attractions.title: Museum of Fine Arts Budapest
attractions.text: See European and Hungarian masterpieces beside Heroes' Square.

sightseeing.tripText: Looking for more ideas? Explore more of Budapest's favourite sights on TripAdvisor.

routes.aria: Open route in Google Maps: Buda Castle District
routes.title: Buda Castle District
routes.text: Explore Buda Castle, Matthias Church and Fisherman's Bastion.

routes.aria: Open route in Google Maps: Downtown Budapest & Parliament
routes.title: Downtown Budapest & Parliament
routes.text: Follow the Danube from Parliament to the Central Market.

routes.aria: Open route in Google Maps: Városliget & Palace Quarter
routes.title: Városliget & Palace Quarter
routes.text: Visit Heroes' Square, Vajdahunyad Castle and Széchenyi Bath.

routes.aria: Open route in Google Maps: Jewish Quarter
routes.title: Jewish Quarter
routes.text: Visit three synagogues, Gozsdu Courtyard and Szimpla Kert.
